import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
shanghai = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [121.3, 31.1], [121.7, 31.1], [121.7, 31.4], [121.3, 31.4], [121.3, 31.1]
])
wuhan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [114.1, 30.4], [114.6, 30.4], [114.6, 30.7], [114.1, 30.7], [114.1, 30.4]
])
start_date = '2020-04-20'
end_date = '2020-05-12'

# 2. Data Acquisition - TROPOMI NO2 data
def get_no2_mean(geometry):
    collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \
        .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(geometry)
    
    if collection.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None, 0
    
    # Calculate mean and count
    mean_img = collection.mean()
    count = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=geometry,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    if count == 0:
        return None, 0
    
    mean_val = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=geometry,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    return mean_val, count

# Get values for both cities
shanghai_mean, shanghai_count = get_no2_mean(shanghai)
wuhan_mean, wuhan_count = get_no2_mean(wuhan)

# 3. Validation & Final Answer
print(f"Shanghai NO2: {shanghai_mean:.6f}, Pixels: {int(shanghai_count)}")
print(f"Wuhan NO2: {wuhan_mean:.6f}, Pixels: {int(wuhan_count)}")

if shanghai_mean is None or wuhan_mean is None:
    if shanghai_mean is None and shanghai_count == 0:
        print("No valid Shanghai data")
    if wuhan_mean is None and wuhan_count == 0:
        print("No valid Wuhan data")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif shanghai_count == 0 or wuhan_count == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif shanghai_mean is None or wuhan_mean is None or shanghai_mean < 0 or wuhan_mean < 0:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif shanghai_mean > wuhan_mean:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
